  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 08, 2023 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300­0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID­19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that
members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s
current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged
provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be
  read at the meeting.
  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant
to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting
agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on
duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS
  AGENDA – FEBRUARY 08, 2023  PAGE 2 of 6
This action permits the City Council to act on ordinances and resolutions without having to
read the entire text of the ordinance or resolution. The title of an ordinance on First
Reading must be read in its entirety. An ordinance on Second Reading does not require
having the title read. However, the City Council may request that an ordinance or resolution
be read in its entirety before taking any action.

  PRESENTATION

1.  PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES TO SAN MARINO LIBRARY
  FOUNDATION BOOKMARK CONTEST WINNERS

  NEW BUSINESS

2.  ACCEPTANCE OF $2,000 DONATION FROM THE SAN MARINO
  COMMUNITY ATHLETICS ASSOCIATION
  Recommendation:
  Staff recommends the Council accept the $2,000 donation from the San Marino
  Community Athletics Association. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be: “I move to (1) accept the
  donation of $2,000 from the San Marino Community Athletics Association; and (2)
  approve the fiscal year 2022­23 expenditure budget amendment of $2,000 in the
  Restricted Donations Fund at Account 281­66­4376­0002 (Track Meet Materials &
  Supplies).”

3.  RECEIVE AND FILE SAN MARINO POLICE DEPARTMENT CRIME
  SUPPRESSION PLAN​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the San Marino
  Police Department Crime Suppression Plan.

4.  CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­23­03 AMENDING THE
  CITY’S FEE SCHEDULE TO ADOPT FEES FOR THE ISSUANCE OF
  CARRYING A CONCEALED WEAPON PERMIT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R­23­
  03 amending the City’s fee schedule to include fees for the issuance of CCW
  licenses. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be: “I move to adopt Resolution No. R­23­03, a Resolution of the San
  Marino City Council amending the City’s Fee Schedule to include fees for the
  issuance of CCW licenses.”

5.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR SECOND QUARTER
  (OCTOBER 2022 THROUGH DECEMBER 2022)
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the Financial
  Report for the Second Quarter (October 2022 through December 2022).

  AGENDA – FEBRUARY 08, 2023  PAGE 3 of 6
6.  RECEIVE AND FILE FISCAL YEAR 2022­23 MID­YEAR FINANCIAL
  REVIEW, UPDATED FIVE­YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST AND LONG­
  TERM FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS REPORT AND APPROVAL OF
  BUDGET AMENDMENTS
   Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R­23­
  03 amending the City’s fee schedule to include fees for the issuance of CCW
  licenses. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be: “I move to adopt Resolution No. R­23­03, a Resolution of the San
  Marino City Council amending the City’s Fee Schedule to include fees for the
  issuance of CCW licenses.”

5.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR SECOND QUARTER
  (OCTOBER 2022 THROUGH DECEMBER 2022)
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the Financial
  Report for the Second Quarter (October 2022 through December 2022).

6.  RECEIVE AND FILE FISCAL YEAR 2022­23 MID­YEAR FINANCIAL
  REVIEW, UPDATED FIVE­YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST AND LONG­
  TERM FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS REPORT AND APPROVAL OF
  BUDGET AMENDMENTS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file this
  report, approve the $3,500,000 transfer to the Capital Projects Fund from General
  Fund Reserves, and authorize the budget amendments noted above. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendations, an appropriate motion would be: “I
  move to receive and file the FY 2022­23 Mid­Year Financial Review, Updated Five­
  Year Financial Forecast, and Long­Term Financial Projections report, approve a
  transfer of $3,500,000 to the Capital Projects Fund from General Fund Reserves, and
  approve the budget amendments as noted in the Staff Report.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

7.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR
  JANUARY 2023​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of January 2023. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:​“I move to receive and
  file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of January 2023.”

8.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF DECEMBER
  2022​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:​“I
  move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of December
  2022.”

9.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the January 2023 minutes.
  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:​“I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of January 11, 2023, the
  regular meeting of January 11, 2023, and the adjourned regular meeting of January
  27, 2023.”

10.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­23­04 TO CONTINUE HYBRID
  PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Resolution No. R­23­04. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:​“I
  move to adopt Resolution No. R­23­04 re­authorizing the City Council and the City’s
  AGENDA
  Boards– FEBRUARY  08, 2023
  and Commissions  to continue teleconference accessibility PAGE  4 of 6
  for conducting
  public meetings pursuant to AB 361.”

11.  UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID­19 PANDEMIC​
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the January 2023 minutes.
  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:​“I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of January 11, 2023, the
  regular meeting of January 11, 2023, and the adjourned regular meeting of January
  27, 2023.”

10.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­23­04 TO CONTINUE HYBRID
  PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Resolution No. R­23­04. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:​“I
  move to adopt Resolution No. R­23­04 re­authorizing the City Council and the City’s
  Boards and Commissions to continue teleconference accessibility for conducting
  public meetings pursuant to AB 361.”

11.  UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID­19 PANDEMIC​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with the staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:​“I move to receive and file the February 8, 2023 report on the City’s response to
  the COVID­19 Pandemic.”

12.  APPROVAL OF $8,100 BUDGET AMENDMENT TO THE FIRE
  DONATIONS CAPITALIZED EQUIPMENT ACCOUNT AND
  APPROPRIATE $21,285 FROM CAPITAL EQUIPMENT FUND
  RESERVES FOR THE PURCHASE OF A MEDICAL CART​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve a budget amendment of the
  Fire Department Donations Fund Capitalized Equipment account and an appropriation
  from the Capital Equipment Fund reserves for the purchase of a medical cart. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:​“I
  move to approve a budget amendment to the Fire Donations account 281­34­4613­
  0562 to $8,100 and an appropriation of $21,285 from the Capital Equipment Fund
  reserves to account 591­34­4613­0562.”

13.  APPROVAL OF THE INSTALLATION AND WAIVING OF COSTS FOR
  THE SAN MARINO SCHOOLS FOUNDATION OF STREET POLE
  BANNERS​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the request from
  the San Marino Schools Foundation and waive the installation costs. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be: ​“I
  move to approve a request from the San Marino Schools Foundation that is in
  accordance with Resolution No. R­14­22 for the installation and display of banners
  citywide between April 1 and June 30.”

14.  APPROVAL OF TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF LACY PARK ON MARCH
  26, 2023 FOR THE GOODEN CENTER OF PASADENA TO HOST A 5K
  RUN FOR RECOVERY EVENT​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the
  delayed opening proposal from The Gooden Center for the purposes of a charity
  running event. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be: ​“ I move to authorize the temporary closure of Lacy
  Park on March 26, 2023 for The Gooden Center Run for Recovery.”

  市議會議程

Steve Talt，市長
  www.CityofSanMarino.org
Steven W. Huang，牙外科博士，副市長
  電話：(626) 300-0700

Mario Rueda，代理市政府執行長

  聖馬力諾市議會
  例會於 2023 年 2 月 8 日（星期三）下午 6 時
  在市政廳市議會會議室舉行，
  地址：2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

聖馬力諾市政府感謝您出席會議。公民參與為市議會提供了有關社區問題的寶貴資訊。

每個月的第二個星期三下午 6 時舉行例會。通常，延期舉行的會議在每個月的最後一個星期五上午 8:30
舉行。

根據《美國殘障人士法》，任何需要合理照顧或便利以參加會議的殘障人士應在會議前與市書記官聯繋，
請求協助，電子郵件：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org；電話：(626)  300-0705。

  根據加州衆議院第 361 號法案（AB 361）
市議員可以透過電話參加會議，而無需告知其參加公開會議的所在地點。

  新冠病毒病（COVID-19）公告
為了保護工作人員、我們的選民和民選官員，建議公眾根據州和縣衛生部當前的衛生官員命令在室內戴口
罩。鑒於新冠病毒的嚴重性，如果您不願意親自出席會議，我們鼓勵您以電子方式提供意見。

議程 — 2023 年 2 月 8 日  第1頁/共6頁
 如何在家中觀看或收聽會議：

  透過電腦接收視頻流：
  網站：https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83316497270
  會議代碼：833 1649 7270
  透過電話僅接收音頻：
  電話號碼：(669) 900-9128
  會議代碼：833 1649 7270

如何在家中發表公衆評議：
  公衆可使用電郵提出評議：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org，截止時間是會議當天下午 3 時，
  由市書記官在公眾評議期間宣讀。為了節省時間，可能會對冗長的公眾評議進行總結。下午 3 時後
  收到的任何評議都將包含在公眾評議紀錄中，但不會在會議上宣讀。
  會議期間提出的公眾評議將透過 zoom.us 電話會議模塊以電子方式接受。透過 Zoom 提出的評議
  將在現場評議發表之後接受。

宣佈開會

宣誓效忠美國

點名

市議員 Chou、市議員 Lo、市議員 Shepherd Romey、副市長 Huang 和市長 Talt

議程發佈

議程會在每次會議前 72 小時於以下地點發佈：City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive；the Crowell
Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive；the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive。議程
還將在市政府網站上發佈：http://www.cityofsanmarino.org。

公衆評議

市政府歡迎公衆提出意見。公眾可以填寫公眾評議卡，並在會議舉行前將其交給市書記官，由市書記官轉
交給市議會。此時，公眾可以就未列入會議議程的事項向市議會提出意見。根據州法，市議會不得討論未
列入會議議程的事項或就這些事項採取行動（《政府法典》第 54954.2 節）。市長保留限制評議時間的
權利。工作人員可能會按照指示對此類事項採取跟進措施。

市政府執行長報告

這是市政府執行長向市議會和公眾通報任何即將發生的事件或社區成員感興趣事項的機會。

放棄進一步閱讀的動議

這一行動允許市議會根據法令和決議採取行動，而無需讀出法令或決議的全文。在一讀時必須完整讀出法

議程 — 2023 年 2 月 8 日  第2頁/共6頁
 令的標題。在二讀時不要求讀出法令的標題。但是，市議會可以要求在採取任何行動之前讀出法令或決議
全文。

  頒發證書

1.  向聖馬力諾市圖書館基金會書籤大賽獲獎者頒發證書

  新議題

2.  接受聖馬力諾市社區田徑協會的  2,000  美元捐款

  建議：
  工作人員建議市議會接受來自聖馬力諾市社區田徑協會的 2,000 美元捐款。如果市議會同意工作
  人員的建議，則適當的動議是：「我提議 (1) 接受聖馬力諾市社區田徑協會捐贈的 2,000 美元；
  (2) 批准帳戶 281-66-4376-0002（田徑運動會材料和用品）中限制捐贈基金 2,000 美元的
  2022-2023 財年支出預算修正案。」

3.  接收並提交聖馬力諾市警察局打擊犯罪計劃

  建議：工作人員建議市議會接收並提交聖馬力諾市警察局打擊犯罪計劃。

4.  考慮  第  R-23-03  號決議，修訂本市費用表，以採納頒發攜帶隱蔽武器許可證費用

  建議：工作人員建議市議會通過 第 R-23-03 號決議，修改本市費用表，包括頒發携帶隱蔽武器（
  CCW）許可證費用。如果市議會同意工作人員的建議，則適當的動議是：「我提議採納 第 R-23-
  03  號決議，此爲聖馬力諾市議會的一項決議，修改了本市的收費表，包括頒發携帶隱蔽武器（
  CCW）許可證的費用。」

5.  接收並提交第二季度（2022  年  10  月至  2022  年  12  月）財務報告

  建議：工作人員建議市議會接收並提交第二季度（2022 年 10 月至 2022 年 12 月）財務報告。

6.  接收並提交 2022-2023 財年中期財務審查、更新五年財務預測和長期財務預測報告以
  及預算修正案的批准

  建議：工作人員建議市議會接收並提交這份報告，批准從普通基金儲備金向資本專案基金轉帳
  3,500,000 美元，並核准上述預算修正案。如果市議會同意工作人員的建議，則適當的動議是：
  「我提議接收並提交 2022-2023 財年中期財務審查、更新五年財務預測和長期財務預測報告，批
  准從普通基金儲備金向資本專案基金轉帳 3,500,000 美元，並批准工作人員報告中提到的預算修
  正案。」

議程 — 2023 年 2 月 8 日  第6頁/共6頁
   同意日曆

7.  接收並提交  2023  年  1  月的月度支出報告

  建議：工作人員建議市議會接收並提交 2023 年 1 月的月度支出報告。如果市議會同意工作人員的
  建議，則適當的動議是：「我提議接收並提交 2023 年 1 月的月度支出報告。」

8.  2022  年  12  月現金和投資報告

  建議：工作人員建議市議會接收並提交這份報告。如果市議會同意工作人員的建議，則適當的動議
  是：「我提議接收並提交 2022 年 12 月現金和投資報告。」

9.  批准會議記錄

  建議：工作人員建議市議會批准 2023 年 1 月的會議記錄。如果市議會同意工作人員的建議，則適
  當的動議是：「我提議批准 2023 年 1 月 11 日特別會議、2023 年 1 月 11 日例會和 2023 年
  1 月 27 日延期舉行的例會的會議記錄。」
10. 採納第  R-23-04  號決議，根據  AB  361  繼續舉行混合公開會議

  建議：工作人員建議市議會採納第 R-23-04 號決議。如果市議會同意工作人員的建議，則適當的
  動議將是：「我提議採納第 R-23-04 號決議，重新授權市議會及市政府各理事會和委員會根據
  AB 361 繼續在召開公衆會議時提供透過電話參加會議的便利。」

11. 市政府應對新冠病毒疫情的最新資訊
